indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX clinic_packet_reservations_event_status_idx ON public.clinic_packet_reservations USING btree (event_id, status, created_at)

indexes.name: clinic_packet_reservations_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX clinic_packet_reservations_pkey ON public.clinic_packet_reservations USING btree (id)

indexes.name: clinic_packet_reservations_render_job_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX clinic_packet_reservations_render_job_id_key ON public.clinic_packet_reservations USING btree (render_job_id)

triggers.name: clinic_packet_reservations_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER clinic_packet_reservations_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.clinic_packet_reservations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION clinic_set_updated_at()

constraints.name: clinic_packet_reservations_clinic_case_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (clinic_case_id) REFERENCES clinic_cases(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: clinic_packet_reservations_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES clinic_events(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: clinic_packet_reservations_packet_credit_ledger_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (packet_credit_ledger_id) REFERENCES packet_credit_ledger(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: clinic_packet_reservations_participant_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (participant_user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: clinic_packet_reservations_render_job_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (render_job_id) REFERENCES packet_render_jobs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
